t: You're looking at America, a marble sculpture by John Bell. It is the marble group representing America on the Albert Memorial. Bell lived from 1811 to 1895 and was a British sculptor whose family home was Hopton Hall in Suffolk. His works were shown at the Great Exhibition of 1851, and this group is the piece he is remembered for here. Look at the figures together as one composition, and notice how the carving has been shaped to be read from below.
